metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting air and somehow landed 1 kill? Valorant’s broken brain time!
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I lost my mouse
Enemy: probably questioning reality
Valorant just said ‘here’s a kill, don’t ask me why’
Click if your aim’s a wild mystery too!

Tap if your kills come from pure chaos too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
